name: Bar/Bistro il Profeta
kurzbeschreibung: **Bar/Bistro il Profeta in Zirl** Discover a cozy, authentic Italian atmosphere in the heart of **Zirl**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. At **il Profeta**, you’ll find a warm welcome, delicious Italian cuisine, and a relaxed vibe—perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes. Savor classic dishes like fresh pasta, wood-fired pizzas, and hearty risottos, all made with locally sourced ingredients. Don’t miss their famous **Tiramisu** or a glass of fine Italian wine to complete your meal. Whether you’re stopping by for a quick espresso, a leisurely lunch, or an evening aperitivo, **il Profeta** offers a taste of Italy right in the mountains. Come for the food, stay for the charm!
